summary: Add a private test-only jobs admission boundary with an always-disabled registry and no constructible execution grant.

replay.detail: No production replay caller or hook. Test-only replay checks immutable signed content without membership, local identity, binding, clock or host-state lookups.

schema.detail: No production schema changes. The private adapter requires a distinct admitted-binding table; its absence is LookupUnavailable, never proven absence. Historical jobs rows are not admitted bindings.

rules.detail: No production registration or callsites. The entire private module is cfg(test), and lookup returns None for EVERY kind, including job.recorded. A real signature without post-sealing nonce/writer-window proof refuses local execution.

compatibility.detail: Registry/validator types, snapshot reads and real local identity source are test-only. LocalExecutionGrant is private and uninhabited. Remote facts can yield only HistoryOnly, not an execution grant.

manual.detail: No operator action. Separate approval and prerequisite rollout are required before 4c-2 admission hooks.

recovery.detail: No execution state is written and no recovery or full-replay trigger is added.
